pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DEMONSTRATIVES AND QUANTIFIERS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication
   In simple words: practise until you can use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers.
4. Show that you can: identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstratives and Quantifiers important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Generate sentences using various demonstratives and quantifiers,
2. Communication and collaboration: It is promoted as the learner works in a team to generate the plural forms of the demonstrative pronouns with peers.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?
2. When do we use demonstratives and quantifiers?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify demonstratives and quantifiers in a given text
2. use demonstratives in sentences for clarity of communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
